rolls_in.sql: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM rolls_inward r LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = r.supplier_id LEFT JOIN qualities q ON q.quality_id = r.quality_id WHERE (r.weigh_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

kg_in.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.kg), 0) FROM rolls_inward r LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = r.supplier_id LEFT JOIN qualities q ON q.quality_id = r.quality_id WHERE (r.weigh_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

avg_roll_kg.sql: SELECT AVG(r.kg) FROM rolls_inward r LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = r.supplier_id LEFT JOIN qualities q ON q.quality_id = r.quality_id WHERE (r.weigh_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

grns.sql: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM grns g LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = g.supplier_id WHERE g.grn_date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

grn_value.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(g.value), 0) FROM grns g LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = g.supplier_id WHERE g.grn_date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

rolls_out.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.rolls), 0) FROM dispatches d LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id WHERE (d.dispatch_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

kg_out.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.kg), 0) FROM dispatches d LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id WHERE (d.dispatch_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

dispatches.sql: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM dispatches d LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id WHERE (d.dispatch_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

stock_kg.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.kg_on_hand), 0) FROM stock_daily s LEFT JOIN qualities q ON q.quality_id = s.quality_id WHERE s.day = (SELECT MAX(s.day) FROM stock_daily s LEFT JOIN qualities q ON q.quality_id = s.quality_id WHERE s.day BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}) {extra}

receivables_open.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.amount - i.paid_amount), 0) FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE TRUE {extra}

receivables_overdue.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.amount - i.paid_amount), 0) FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE i.is_overdue = TRUE {extra}

gst_payable.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(g.gst_payable), 0) FROM gst_monthly g WHERE g.month BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

fuel_litres.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.litres), 0) FROM fuel_fills f LEFT JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id = f.vehicle_id WHERE (f.fill_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

fuel_spend.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.amount), 0) FROM fuel_fills f LEFT JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id = f.vehicle_id WHERE (f.fill_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

km.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.km), 0) FROM trips t LEFT JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id = t.vehicle_id WHERE t.trip_date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

fuel_per_km.sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.litres), 0) FROM fuel_fills f LEFT JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id = f.vehicle_id WHERE (f.fill_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(t.km) FROM trips t LEFT JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id = t.vehicle_id WHERE t.trip_date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}), 0)

distinct_vehicles.sql: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT f.vehicle_id), 0) FROM fuel_fills f LEFT JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id = f.vehicle_id WHERE (f.fill_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

fuel_budget.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.fuel_budget), 0) FROM budgets b WHERE b.month BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

orders.sql: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN channels h ON h.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

order_value.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.order_value), 0) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN channels h ON h.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

distinct_customers.sql: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 0) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN channels h ON h.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}

value_per_order.sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.order_value), 0) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN channels h ON h.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN channels h ON h.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN {from} AND {to} {extra}), 0)

receivables_open.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.amount - i.paid_amount), 0) FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE TRUE {extra}
